instruction:
Office Schedule Metadata From Init Model

This task starts from Desktop input file: /home/user/Desktop/init.osm. Reference image is provided on the Desktop: /home/user/Desktop/init_plan.png. Modify the OpenStudio 3.10 model as needed and save the required output as /home/user/Desktop/result.osm.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains /home/user/Desktop/result.osm with size at least 500 bytes.
2. /home/user/Desktop/result.osm contains exactly one OS:Version object whose version identifier starts with 3.10.
3. /home/user/Desktop/result.osm contains exactly 1 OS:BuildingStory, 4 OS:Space objects, and 4 OS:ThermalZone objects.
4. The OS:Space names are exactly Office-A, Office-B, Conference, and Support.
5. Every OS:Space references the OS:BuildingStory, references an OS:ThermalZone, and has floor area greater than 0.05 m2.
6. The model has exactly 26 OS:Surface objects: 4 Floor surfaces, 4 RoofCeiling surfaces, and 18 Wall surfaces.
7. The surface Outside Boundary Condition counts are exactly 4 Ground, 12 Outdoors, and 10 Surface.
8. The model has exactly 0 OS:SubSurface objects.
9. The model contains exactly 4 OS:ZoneHVAC:IdealLoadsAirSystem objects, 4 OS:ZoneHVAC:EquipmentList objects, 4 OS:ThermostatSetpoint:DualSetpoint objects, 2 OS:People objects, 2 OS:Lights objects, and 2 OS:ElectricEquipment objects.
10. Office-A, Office-B, and Conference use an OS:SpaceType named OfficeType whose default schedule set is Office Defaults; Support uses an OS:SpaceType named SupportType whose default schedule set is Support Defaults.
11. The surface geometry bounding box has X span 16.00 m, Y span 12.00 m, and Z span 3.20 m, each with tolerance +/-0.05 m.
12. The sum of floor surface areas is 192.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2.
13. The sum of exterior wall gross areas is 179.20 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
